messages:
Rae (Design): quick microcopy pass for Model versions page before tomorrow's ship. three small items: empty state, quantize error, and overwrite confirm.
Tom (ML Eng): nice. users keep filing support tickets about the quantize failure message.
Ellen (Support): current error is: "Upload failed: artifact missing" which led customers to worry their model was deleted.
Rae (Design): propose clearer error: `Upload failed: we couldn't find the model artifact on the server. Please re-run the export or contact support. Error code: QNTZ_101.` Short, explains cause and next step.
Kai (Product): include a help link inline? maybe `See troubleshooting` that opens docs.
Rae (Design): added: `Upload failed: we couldn't find the model artifact on the server. Try re-exporting the model or see troubleshooting.` link anchors. Keep the error code at the end.
Tom (ML Eng): also include the quantize-specific hint: `This often happens when the export ZIP is missing model.bin. If you're using our CLI, run: `rw-export --include-weights``. Keep it collapsible to avoid noise.
a11y-bot: For errors, ensure `role=alert` and visible DOM text matches what screen readers will announce. Avoid relying only on a toast.
Rae (Design): noted. moving to empty state for Model versions: current: "No versions yet" with `Upload` CTA. propose: heading `No model versions uploaded` body `Upload a model to create versioned artifacts. We recommend tagging stable releases as v1, v2, etc., so rollouts and revert work smoothly.` CTA `Upload model`.
Ellen (Support): love the tagging suggestion. reduces support questions. Also add alt text for the illustration: `Illustration: empty shelf with a package`.
Kai (Product): final item: overwrite confirmation when uploading a version with an existing tag. Current copy: "Overwrite existing version?" vague.
Rae (Design): suggested dialog: heading `Replace version "v1"?` body `Uploading will replace the existing artifacts for version "v1" across Dedicated and Private deployments. Running instances will continue using the currently loaded model until they restart. This action cannot be undone from the Console. Consider creating a new version if you want to preserve the old artifacts.` Buttons: `Cancel` and danger `Replace version`.
Tom (ML Eng): accurate. also add telemetry event `version_replace_confirmed`.
a11y-bot: Dialog needs `role=alertdialog`, `aria-labelledby` and focus on Cancel by default. Provide descriptive `aria-describedby` for the long body.
Rae (Design): thanks everyone. I'll add the copy to the PR comments and attach small screenshots. Ellen, can you add the support KB link to the error message?
Ellen (Support): will do. adding a short troubleshooting doc and linking the error code.
Kai (Product): approved from product side. adding a release blurb: "Clarified Model versions copy: errors, empty state, and overwrite confirmation to reduce support confusion."
Rae (Design): PR incoming. closing thread. :sparkles:
